value.rationale: This is a complete natural invariant of all Jordan chains of lengths at least three for a canonical 10-dimensional nilpotent Lie algebra. It gives a genuine modular resonance: characteristic three disallows size-four blocks without size-three blocks and increases the dimension and changes the component structure of the N³=0 variety. It is not a textbook first-rank count or an arbitrary small slice.
